images.author: Coke Smith
images.why: Solitary dark, shaggy wild yak beside water in Yeniugou, Qinghai. Photographer explicitly separates Bos mutus photographs from domestic yaks. Strong species provenance; native pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: Coke Smith

images.author: Jennifer Leigh Warner
images.why: Kaziranga buffalo with broad horns and a strong reflection, offering an appealing vertical composition. Legs are submerged. Direct 2500w image variant; native resolution unverified.

images.author: Daniel Erlandson
